def compress(grid):
    """The grid without its frontiers: every row and every column that is one color throughout."""
    rows = {i for i, row in enumerate(grid) if len(set(row)) == 1}
    cols = {j for j in range(len(grid[0])) if len({row[j] for row in grid}) == 1}
    return [[v for j, v in enumerate(row) if j not in cols] for i, row in enumerate(grid) if i not in rows]

def upscale(grid, factor):
    """Each cell as a factor x factor block of its color."""
    return [[v for v in row for _ in range(factor)] for row in grid for _ in range(factor)]

def crop(grid, top, left, height, width):
    """The height x width subgrid whose top-left cell is (top, left)."""
    return [row[left:left + width] for row in grid[top:top + height]]

def trim(grid):
    """The grid without its outermost rows and columns."""
    return [row[1:-1] for row in grid[1:-1]]

def replace(grid, old, new):
    """The grid with every cell of color old recolored new."""
    return [[new if v == old else v for v in row] for row in grid]

def hperiod(grid):
    """The smallest p such that every row repeats itself every p cells: the grid's width if none is smaller."""
    w = len(grid[0])
    return next(p for p in range(1, w + 1) if all(row[j] == row[j - p] for row in grid for j in range(p, w)))

def transform(g):
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    from collections import Counter
    cnt=Counter(x for row in g for x in row)
    G=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    # bars: colored runs in row0 and last row
    bars=set(g[0])|set(g[-1]); bars.discard(G)
    B=bars.pop()
    Mc=[c for c in cnt if c not in (G,B)][0]
    L,C=max(Mc,G),min(Mc,G)
    top=sorted(i for i,x in enumerate(g[0]) if x==B)
    bot=sorted(i for i,x in enumerate(g[-1]) if x==B)
    tspan=(top[0],top[-1]); bspan=(bot[0],bot[-1])
    marks=[(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if g[r][c]==Mc]
    mcols={c for r,c in marks}
    out=[[C]*w for _ in range(h)]
    # bars
    for c in range(tspan[0],tspan[1]+1): out[0][c]=B
    for c in range(bspan[0],bspan[1]+1): out[-1][c]=B
    # markers and lines below (to row above bottom bar)
    for r,c in marks:
        out[r][c]=4
        for rr in range(r+1,h-1): out[rr][c]=L
    # offsets measured from right end of the bar span containing markers
    if all(bspan[0]<=c<=bspan[1] for c in mcols):
        near, far = bspan, tspan; near_is_bottom=True
    else:
        near, far = tspan, bspan; near_is_bottom=False
    offs={near[1]-c for c in mcols}
    width=near[1]-near[0]+1
    farcols={far[1]-o for o in offs}
    # far-top full lines (only when markers under bottom bar), unless full coverage -> include last row
    if near_is_bottom:
        last = h-1 if len(offs)==width else h-2
        for c in farcols:
            for rr in range(1,last+1): out[rr][c]=L
    # gap lines: full height, color G, bars override
    for span in (tspan,bspan):
        gaps={span[1]-o for o in range(span[1]-span[0]+1)}-{span[1]-o for o in offs} if span==near else set()
        # gaps for far bar use same offs
        if span!=near:
            gaps={span[1]-o for o in offs if 0<=o<=span[1]-span[0]} # offsets valid within far span
            gaps={span[1]-o for o in offs}
            gaps={c for c in gaps if span[0]<=c<=span[1]}
        # near bar gaps:
        else:
            gaps={span[1]-o for o in range(span[1]-span[0]+1)} - offs
        for c in gaps:
            for rr in range(h): out[rr][c]=G
    # bars override again
    for c in range(tspan[0],tspan[1]+1): out[0][c]=B
    for c in range(bspan[0],bspan[1]+1): out[-1][c]=B
    return out
